en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor seawater swimming stadium with terraced concrete stands around a rectangular pool, sandy beach area in the foreground with bathers, and a tall diving platform. In the background are fortification walls and buildings, and to the far right industrial buildings with smoke from chimneys. Printed captions in Swedish appear in the lower left and right corners.
